title: Reproduction comparison record
description: On-disk machine-readable comparison written by reproduction-executor to <attempt_dir>/comparisons/comparison.json (agent definition v1.1, workflow step 4). One record per locked target id from the approved plan — no more, no fewer (pipeline invariant 3); scripts/reproduction-lane.py check-attempt enforces the one-to-one match and recomputes coverage from the outcomes. Outcome categories are the verdicts-and-precision v1.0 discrepancy classification plus PAPER_ERROR (its paper-error handling rule). Coverage numerator per coverage-rules v1.0: targets reproduced exactly or within pre-stated tolerance = EXACT_MATCH, WITHIN_PRECISION, WITHIN_CONFIDENCE.

plan_sha256.description: sha256 of the approved reproduction-plan.json this comparison scores against

testable.description: False when the target could not be tested (missing data, unbuildable environment); untestable targets stay in the denominator

failure_mode.description: Required in substance when testable is false or the outcome is CANNOT_COMPARE

evidence.description: Path (relative to the attempt directory) of the value-level detail file, or the comparison procedure for visual targets

escalations.description: PAPER_ERROR and CANNOT_COMPARE calls surface for human confirmation before entering study data (modernisation plan §4.4)
